_comment: Slipstream (tow) + dirty air (card). TOW: a car 5-40 m behind another (minRangeM..maxRangeM), inside its wake (wakeWidthCars x car width, widening by wakeWiden at max range) and heading within maxAngleDeg of it gets up to maxDragReduction less aero drag: strongest close, fading to zero at max range, scaled by alignment. Several cars ahead: the strongest tow, never stacked. DIRTY AIR: within dirtyRangeM behind a car while cornering harder than cornerG, up to maxDownforceLoss of downforce goes (0 = off), so the tow is a straight-line weapon. aiTowEagerness: how keenly AI difficulty presets tuck in behind a car on a straight (0 = never). wind / wake: client feedback (sound when tucked in, faint VFX streaks on high).
